label: Three coarse schema controls: local face-value status with a matched religious truth difference…
paraphrase: Three coarse schema controls: local face-value status with a matched religious truth difference; the stronger uniform profile with some sentence truth difference and no matched religious truth difference; and matched invariance with local face-value failure. The second does not export nonreligious status of the varying sentence, and the third does not identify which local clause fails. RELIGIOUS-DETAILED-SEMANTIC-CONTROLS separately exports the stronger advertised distinctions.
